Implementation Plan

Planning ref: `claude/fix-main-ci-green` @ `60c11e08a333db7b6853754096f15f3cc5c20abe`. This matches the issue's integration branch.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends `.github/ai/write_guards.v1.json` + `scripts/write_guard.sh::write_guard_check`, and the trusted-support checkout pattern in `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml` ("Resolve … support" → "Checkout trusted activation support" → "Verify trusted activation support")
Scope-mode justification: The plan does what the three answers ask (Q1:A, Q2:A, Q3:A) and nothing more, with two additions that make it deliverable and effective. (1) `write_guard_check` currently reads the policy from the editor-modified worktree first (`write_guard_resolve_config_path`, `scripts/write_guard.sh:35-58`). A commit that adds the new block entries and also edits `.github/workflows/sync-claude-live-copies.yml` would then block itself. It would also let an AI editor loosen or delete the policy inside the same commit the policy is judging. Evaluating the policy as committed at `HEAD` fixes both; it is about 20 lines. (2) Q3:A names the resolver, but the resolver has no write-guard call today, so it needs one call site and a `conflict_resolver` policy entry. Adding the same two paths to `validate_fix_harness` costs two lines and finishes "the AI pipeline cannot commit to them", so it is included under the Boil-the-Lake rule (§6: Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed). The script itself is not changed.

## Automation / scheduler surface (§20.E)
- New scripts: none. The change modifies an existing workflow, a shared helper, a policy JSON, the resolver script, one test helper, and adds one pytest file.
- Entry point: `.github/workflows/sync-claude-live-copies.yml` (trigger: `push` to `main` touching `workflow-templates/.claude/**`), with the same trigger as today. The new contract test runs in the existing `.github/workflows/ci.yml` step "Live .claude/ copies match their templates" (job `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`). `scripts/dev/test_write_guard.sh` already runs in `ci.yml` (around line 873).
- Long-running supervisor: none needed.
- DB work: none.
- `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`: no entry, since nothing is single-use, long-running or a supervisor.

## Conflicts / findings from the codebase
- F1. The stable tag does not contain the sync script. `refs/tags/stable` is an annotated tag that peels to `df70982624d4c2b8f2fd9693f8f61a85f01bd416` (2026-10-03), and that commit has no `scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py`; it does have `scripts/tg_helpers.sh`. Under Q1:A the sync is therefore a no-op until the next stable release includes the script. The plan treats this as "optional support absent → skip with a warning", never as a reason to run the pushed copy.
- F2. The write-guard policy exists at `.github/ai/write_guards.v1.json`; the clarifier's "missing context" note was wrong. Phases today are `implement`, `plan`, `review_editor` and `validate_fix_harness`, and there is no `conflict_resolver` phase.
- F3. `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh` never calls `write_guard_check`. Its only path gates are the allowlist / workflow-hallucination guard (around lines 2840-2872) and `check_resolver_diff.sh`.
- F4. `write_guard_check` fails open on config errors (`WRITE_GUARD_CONFIG_ERROR … return 0`). This is existing behaviour and stays unchanged.
- F5. Push credentials today come only from the checkout's persisted `GH_PAT` (`actions/checkout` `token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}`), which `_commit_and_push` uses via `git push origin` (`scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py:509`). With `persist-credentials: false`, the push needs credentials supplied another way.

## 1. Files likely to change
1. `.github/workflows/sync-claude-live-copies.yml`: run the sync from the stable support checkout, check out without persisted credentials, and give GH_PAT only to the support-copy step.
2. `.github/ai/write_guards.v1.json`: add the two guarded paths to `blocked_globs` of `implement`, `review_editor` and `validate_fix_harness`, and add a new `conflict_resolver` phase.
3. `scripts/write_guard.sh`: evaluate the committed `HEAD` policy when the repo-root policy is tracked at `HEAD`.
4. `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh`: source `write_guard.sh` from support and call `write_guard_check conflict_resolver` before and after the model runs.
5. `scripts/dev/test_write_guard.sh`: update the two cases that edit or remove the worktree policy without committing (around lines 188 and 200), and add cases for HEAD-preference.
6. New `tests/test_sync_claude_live_copies_workflow_contract.py`.
7. `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: add the new test file to the existing "Live .claude/ copies match their templates" pytest command line. No new step or job.
8. `agents.md`: update the "Live `.claude/` copies and their templates" bullet about the sync workflow (stable-pinned execution, credential scoping, write-guard protection). Add `WRITE_GUARD_POLICY_HEAD` to the stable log-prefix bullet list and to the `LOG_PREFIX.name=` block.
9. New `changelog.d/<issue-number>-sync-live-copies-trusted-support.md` (CLAUDE.md §20 fragment).
Not changed: `scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py`. Its CLI (`--root`, `sync --before --after`), the held-PR path, the `CLAUDE_LIVE_SYNC` log lines, the divergence allowlist and the parity behaviour all stay as they are.

## 2. Functions / modules to implement

A. `.github/workflows/sync-claude-live-copies.yml`
Keep `on:`, `permissions: contents: read`, `concurrency`, the job id `sync`, the step id `sync`, the step name "Sync template-only .claude changes to the live copy" and the outputs `held`, `held_pr`, `held_summary`. Steps, in order:
1. New "Resolve trusted sync support" (`id: resolve_support`), with env `GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}` and `REPO: ${{ github.repository }}`.
   - `gh api "repos/${REPO}/git/ref/tags/stable"`.
   - If `.object.type == "tag"`, follow it with `gh api "repos/${REPO}/git/tags/<sha>"`. Require the final `.object.type == "commit"` and a SHA matching `^[0-9a-f]{40}$`. Otherwise emit `::error::` and exit 1. This is the same peel logic as `issue_pr_status.yml:764-781`.
   - Write `support_sha` to `GITHUB_OUTPUT`.
2. New "Checkout trusted sync support": `actions/checkout@v5` with `ref: ${{ steps.resolve_support.outputs.support_sha }}`, `path: .codex-workflow-src`, `persist-credentials: false`, `fetch-depth: 1`. No `token:`, so it uses `github.token`.
3. New "Verify trusted sync support" (`id: verify_support`):
   - `git -C .codex-workflow-src rev-parse HEAD` must equal `SUPPORT_SHA` (passed via env), otherwise `::error::` and exit 1.
   - If `.codex-workflow-src/scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py` is absent, emit `::warning::CLAUDE_LIVE_SYNC skipped reason=support_script_missing support_sha=<sha>` and set `available=false`. Otherwise set `available=true`.
4. "Checkout repository" (name kept): `path: target`, `fetch-depth: 0`, `persist-credentials: false`. Remove `token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}`. Replace the comment so it explains that GH_PAT reaches only the pinned support script.
5. "Sync template-only .claude changes to the live copy" (`id: sync`):
   - Add `if: steps.verify_support.outputs.available == 'true'` and `working-directory: target`. Env as today (`GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}`, `PUSH_BEFORE`, `PUSH_AFTER`, `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE`).
   - Body:
     - `set -euo pipefail`; fail with `::error::` when `GH_TOKEN` is empty.
     - `sync_basic="$(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "${GH_TOKEN}" | base64 -w0)"`, then `echo "::add-mask::${sync_basic}"`.
     - `export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0="http.https://github.com/.extraheader" GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0="AUTHORIZATION: basic ${sync_basic}"`. This is the same header `actions/checkout` persists, but it lives only in this step's process environment. It works with whichever script version stable ships, and does not show up in argv.
     - `python3 "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.codex-workflow-src/scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py" --root "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/target" sync --before "${PUSH_BEFORE}" --after "${PUSH_AFTER}"`.
6. "Alert on held .claude live-copy sync": keep the name and `if:`, but change `source scripts/tg_helpers.sh` to `source "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.codex-workflow-src/scripts/tg_helpers.sh"`. TG secrets must no longer run code from the pushed commit.

Check the file with `actionlint`. It must stay 2-space YAML; size is not a concern under §24.

B. `scripts/write_guard.sh::write_guard_check`
- After `write_guard_config_path` is resolved, and only when `git -C "${write_guard_root_dir}" cat-file -e "HEAD:${write_guard_config_rel}"` succeeds:
  - Write `git show "HEAD:${rel}"` into a new `mktemp` file. Use a new local such as `write_guard_head_config_file`; check uniqueness against the existing `write_guard_*` locals.
  - Use that file as `write_guard_config_path`. This applies whether the worktree copy was edited, deleted or left alone.
  - When the worktree copy is missing or differs from the HEAD blob (`cmp -s`), print `WRITE_GUARD_POLICY_HEAD: phase=<phase> config=<rel> reason=worktree_differs|worktree_missing`.
  - Keep `write_guard_config_log_path` as the relative path so existing `WRITE_GUARD_CONFIG_ERROR … config=` log strings do not change.
- If `git show` fails, keep the existing candidate order.
- Remove the temp file on every return path.
- Untracked or non-git roots, and consumers without a committed root policy, behave exactly as before.

C. `.github/ai/write_guards.v1.json`
- Append `"scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py"` and `".github/workflows/sync-claude-live-copies.yml"` to `blocked_globs` of `implement`, `review_editor` and `validate_fix_harness`.
- Add `"conflict_resolver": { "allowed_globs": ["**"], "blocked_globs": [".git/**", "scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py", ".github/workflows/sync-claude-live-copies.yml"], "conditional_blocked_globs": [] }`.
- Leave `schema_version` unchanged.
